WITH CTE_AUFNR AS
    	(
        -- Changed via AFRU (confirmation) timestamps
        	SELECT AUFK.AUFNR
        	FROM ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AUFK  WITH (NOLOCK)

        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFKO WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON AUFK.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AUFK.AUFNR  = AFKO.AUFNR
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFIH WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFIH.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AFIH.AUFNR  = AFKO.AUFNR
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFVC WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFVC.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AFVC.AUFPL  = AFKO.AUFPL
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFRU WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFRU.MANDT  = AFVC.MANDT
				AND AFRU.RUECK  = AFVC.RUECK
	
        	WHERE  CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(AFRU.UPDATETS, 8), 112) >= '2024-01-01'
	
        	UNION
	
        	-- Changed via AFVC (operation) timestamps
	
        	SELECT AUFK.AUFNR
			FROM ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AUFK  WITH (NOLOCK)
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFKO WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AUFK.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AUFK.AUFNR  = AFKO.AUFNR
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFIH WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFIH.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AFIH.AUFNR  = AFKO.AUFNR
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFVC WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFVC.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AFVC.AUFPL  = AFKO.AUFPL
	
        	WHERE  CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(AFVC.UPDATETS, 8), 112) >= '2024-01-01'
	
        	UNION
	
        	-- Changed via AUFK (order header) timestamps
	
        	SELECT AUFNR
        	FROM ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AUFK WITH (NOLOCK)
	
        	WHERE  CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(AUFK.UPDATETS, 8), 112) >= '2024-01-01'
	
        	UNION
	
        	-- Changed via AFIH (maintenance order info) timestamps
	
        	SELECT AUFNR
        	FROM   ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFIH WITH (NOLOCK)
	
        	WHERE  CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(AFIH.UPDATETS, 8), 112) >= '2024-01-01'
	
        	UNION
	
        	-- Changed via AFKO (order routing) timestamps
	
        	SELECT AUFNR
        	FROM   ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFKO WITH (NOLOCK)
	
        	WHERE  CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(AFKO.UPDATETS, 8), 112) >= '2024-01-01'
	
        	UNION
	
        	-- Orders where operation status (JEST) changed to RELE (I0010)
	
        	SELECT DISTINCT AUFK.AUFNR
        	FROM   ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AUFK  WITH (NOLOCK)
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFKO WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AUFK.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AUFK.AUFNR  = AFKO.AUFNR
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFIH WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFIH.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AFIH.AUFNR  = AFKO.AUFNR
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFVC WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFVC.MANDT  = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AFVC.AUFPL  = AFKO.AUFPL
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.JEST WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  JEST.MANDT   = AFVC.MANDT
				AND JEST.OBJNR   = AFVC.OBJNR
	
        	WHERE  JEST.STAT = 'I0010'
        		AND  CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(JEST.UPDATETS, 8), 112) >= '2024-01-01'
		),

    /* =========================================================================
       STEP 2a : Pull AUFK header fields for each changed order
       ========================================================================= */

    	CTE_AUFK AS
    	(
        	SELECT
            	AUFK.MANDT      AS AUFK_MANDT,
            	AUFK.AUFNR      AS AUFK_AUFNR,
            	AUFK.BUKRS      AS AUFK_BUKRS,
            	AUFK.ERDAT      AS AUFK_ERDAT,
            	AUFK.KDAUF      AS AUFK_KDAUF,
            	AUFK.KDPOS      AS AUFK_KDPOS,
            	AUFK.PRCTR      AS AUFK_PRCTR,
            	AUFK.IDAT2      AS AUFK_IDAT2
        	FROM   ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AUFK WITH (NOLOCK)

        	INNER JOIN CTE_AUFNR 
				ON CTE_AUFNR.AUFNR = AUFK.AUFNR
		),

    /* =========================================================================
       STEP 2b : Collect released-status flag per operation object
                 (JEST STAT = 'I0010' = RELeased, INACT <> 'X')
       ========================================================================= */

    	CTE_JEST AS
    	(
        	SELECT DISTINCT
            	AFVC.OBJNR,
            	JEST.STAT
        	FROM  CTE_AUFNR

        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFKO WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  CTE_AUFNR.AUFNR = AFKO.AUFNR
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFIH WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFIH.MANDT = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AFIH.AUFNR = AFKO.AUFNR
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFVC WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  AFVC.MANDT = AFKO.MANDT
				AND AFVC.AUFPL = AFKO.AUFPL
	
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.JEST WITH (NOLOCK) 
				ON  JEST.MANDT  = AFVC.MANDT
				AND JEST.OBJNR  = AFVC.OBJNR

        	WHERE JEST.INACT <> 'X' AND  JEST.STAT = 'I0010'
   	 	),

    /* =========================================================================
       STEP 3 : Raw source extract  (mirrors DELTA_KEYS_TMCONFSO staging)
                Joins all relevant SAP tables and adds partner / JEST flag.
       ========================================================================= */

    	CTE_SOURCE AS
		(
        	SELECT DISTINCT
            	CTE_AUFK.AUFK_MANDT,
            	CTE_AUFK.AUFK_AUFNR,
            	CTE_AUFK.AUFK_BUKRS,
            	CTE_AUFK.AUFK_ERDAT,
            	CTE_AUFK.AUFK_KDAUF,
            	CTE_AUFK.AUFK_KDPOS,
            	CTE_AUFK.AUFK_PRCTR,
            	CTE_AUFK.AUFK_IDAT2,
            	AFKO.AUFPL          AS AFKO_AUFPL,
            	AFIH.IWERK          AS AFIH_IWERK,
            	AFVC.APLZL          AS AFVC_APLZL,
            	AFVC.ARBID          AS AFVC_ARBID,
            	AFVC.KTSCH          AS AFVC_KTSCH,
            	AFVC.LTXA1          AS AFVC_LTXA1,
            	AFVC.PLNFL          AS AFVC_PLNFL,
            	AFVC.RUECK          AS AFVC_RUECK,
            	AFVC.VORNR          AS AFVC_VORNR,
            	AFRU.BEMOT          AS AFRU_BEMOT,
            	AFRU.BUDAT          AS AFRU_BUDAT,
            	AFRU.ERNAM          AS AFRU_ERNAM,
            	AFRU.ERSDA          AS AFRU_ERSDA,
            	AFRU.GRUND          AS AFRU_GRUND,
            	AFRU.ISMNE          AS AFRU_ISMNE,
            	AFRU.ISMNW          AS AFRU_ISMNW,
            	AFRU.LEARR          AS AFRU_LEARR,
            	AFRU.LTXA1          AS AFRU_LTXA1,
            	AFRU.OFMNE          AS AFRU_OFMNE,
            	AFRU.OFMNW          AS AFRU_OFMNW,
            	AFRU.PERNR          AS AFRU_PERNR,
            	AFRU.RMZHL          AS AFRU_RMZHL,
            	AFRU.STZHL          AS AFRU_STZHL,
            	AFRU.WERKS          AS AFRU_WERKS,
            	AFVU.USR04          AS AFVU_USR04,
            	VBAK.KUNNR          AS VBAK_KUNNR,
				VBAK.SPART          AS VBAK_SPART,
            	VBAK.VKORG          AS VBAK_VKORG,
            	VBAK.VTWEG          AS VBAK_VTWEG,
            	VBAK.ZZMARKET_CODE  AS VBAK_ZZMARKET_CODE,
            	CRCO.KOSTL          AS CRCO_KOSTL,
	
            -- AFRU_AUERU: 'Y' if operation is in Released status, else 'N'
	
            	CASE WHEN CTE_JEST.STAT = 'I0010' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS AFRU_AUERU,
	
            -- ZH partner (parent customer) from KNVP
	
            	KNVP.KUNN2          AS ZH_KUNN2

        	FROM   CTE_AUFK

        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFKO WITH (NOLOCK)
               ON  CTE_AUFK.AUFK_MANDT = AFKO.MANDT
               AND CTE_AUFK.AUFK_AUFNR = AFKO.AUFNR

        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFIH WITH (NOLOCK)
               ON  AFIH.MANDT = AFKO.MANDT
               AND AFIH.AUFNR = AFKO.AUFNR

        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFVC WITH (NOLOCK)
               ON  AFVC.MANDT = AFKO.MANDT
               AND AFVC.AUFPL = AFKO.AUFPL
 
        	INNER JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFRU WITH (NOLOCK)
               ON  AFRU.MANDT = AFVC.MANDT
               AND AFRU.RUECK = AFVC.RUECK

        	LEFT  JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFVV WITH (NOLOCK)
               ON  AFVV.MANDT = AFVC.MANDT
               AND AFVV.AUFPL = AFVC.AUFPL
               AND AFVV.APLZL = AFVC.APLZL

        	LEFT  JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.AFVU WITH (NOLOCK)
               ON  AFVU.MANDT = AFVC.MANDT
               AND AFVU.AUFPL = AFVC.AUFPL
               AND AFVU.APLZL = AFVC.APLZL

        	LEFT  JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.VBAK WITH (NOLOCK)
               ON  VBAK.MANDT = CTE_AUFK.AUFK_MANDT
               AND VBAK.VBELN = CTE_AUFK.AUFK_KDAUF

        	LEFT  JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.CRCO WITH (NOLOCK)
               ON  CRCO.MANDT = AFVC.MANDT
               AND CRCO.OBJID = AFVC.ARBID
               AND CRCO.ENDDA = '99991231'

        	LEFT  JOIN CTE_JEST
               ON  CTE_JEST.OBJNR = AFVC.OBJNR

        -- lookup_ext: KNVP partner function ZH (parent customer)

        	LEFT  JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.KNVP WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON  KNVP.KUNNR  = VBAK.KUNNR
				AND KNVP.VKORG  = VBAK.VKORG
                AND KNVP.VTWEG  = VBAK.VTWEG
               	AND KNVP.SPART  = VBAK.SPART
               	AND KNVP.PARVW  = 'ZH'
    	),

    /* =========================================================================
       STEP 4 : Apply all dimension lookups and derived transformations
                (mirrors Query_Lookups view in Data Services)
                All lookup_ext() calls become LEFT JOINs on GLOBAL_EDW
                dimension tables, filtered to ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'.
                Calculated columns:
                  ACTUAL_WRK        : reverse sign if STZHL <> '00000000'
                  ACTUAL_WRK_IN_HRS : convert MIN to HR, apply cancellation sign
                  REMG_WRK_IN_HRS   : convert MIN to HR, apply cancellation sign
                  WRK_IN_HRS_UOM    : hardcoded 'H'
                  ETL_SRC_SYS_CD    : derived from MANDT
       ========================================================================= */

    	CTE_TRANSFORMED AS
    	(
        	SELECT
 
            /* --- Dimension surrogate keys (lookup_ext results) --- */
 
            	ISNULL(D_SEG.SEG_KEY,             -1) AS SEGMENT_CD_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_SORD.SERVC_ORDER_KEY,    -1) AS SERVC_ORDER_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_CMPNY.CMPNY_KEY,         -1) AS CMPNY_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_PRCTR.PROFT_CNTR_KEY,    -1) AS PROFT_CNTR_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_SALORD.SALES_ORDER_KEY,  -1) AS SALES_ORDER_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_CUST.CUST_KEY,           -1) AS SOLDTO_CUST_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_WRKCTR.WRK_CNTR_KEY,     -1) AS WRK_CNTR_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_COSCTR.COST_CNTR_KEY,    -1) AS COST_CNTR_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_PSTDT.DATE_KEY,          -1) AS PSTNG_DATE_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_OPLNT.PLNT_KEY,          -1) AS OPERATING_PLNT_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_PERNR.PERSONEL_KEY,      -1) AS PERSONEL_NUM_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_ACTTYP.ACTIVITY_TYP_KEY, -1) AS ACTIVITY_TYP_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_PLPLNT.PLNT_KEY,         -1) AS PLNG_PLNT_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_SALAREA.SALES_AREA_KEY,  -1) AS SALES_AREA_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_CREDT.DATE_KEY,          -1) AS CREATED_ON_DATE_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_PCUST.CUST_KEY,          -1) AS PARNT_CUST_KEY,
            	ISNULL(D_TECHDT.DATE_KEY,         -1) AS TCHNCL_COMPLETION_DATE_KEY,
	
            /* --- Reason for variance description (TRUGT lookup) --- */
	
            	ISNULL(TRG.GRDTX, '')           AS RSN_FOR_VRNC_DESC,
	
            /* --- Accounting indicator description (TBMOTX lookup) --- */
	
            	ISNULL(BMOT.BEMOT_TXT, '')      AS ACCTNG_IND_DESC,
	
            /* --- Keys for target PK (renamed in Query_Rename) --- */
	
            	SRC.AFKO_AUFPL          AS OPERATION_TASK_LIST_ID,
            	SRC.AFVC_APLZL          AS OPERATION_COUNTER_ID,
            	SRC.AFVC_VORNR          AS OPERATION_ACTIVITY_ID,
            	SRC.AFVC_RUECK          AS OPERATION_CONFIRM_ID,
            	SRC.AFVC_PLNFL          AS OPERATION_SEQ_ID,
            	--SRC.AUFK_KDPOS          AS SALES_ORDER_ITM_NBR,
				CAST(SRC.AUFK_KDPOS AS VARCHAR(20)) AS SALES_ORDER_ITM_NBR,
            	SRC.AUFK_KDAUF          AS SALES_ORDER_ID,
	
            /* --- Descriptive / measure columns --- */
	
            	SRC.AFVC_KTSCH          AS OPERATION_STD_TEXT,
            	SRC.AFVC_LTXA1          AS OPERATION_SHORT_TEXT,
            	SRC.AFRU_LTXA1          AS OPERATION_CONFIRM_TEXT,
            	SRC.AFRU_GRUND          AS RSN_FOR_VRNC,
            	SRC.AFRU_STZHL          AS CONFIRM_COUNTER_OF_CANCELLED_CO,
            	SRC.AFRU_AUERU          AS PARTIAL_FINAL_CONFIRM,
            	SRC.AFRU_BEMOT          AS ACCTNG_IND,
            	SRC.AFRU_ISMNE          AS ACTUAL_WRK_UOM,
            	SRC.AFRU_OFMNE          AS REMG_WRK_UOM,
            	SRC.AFRU_ERNAM          AS PERSON_WHO_ENTERERD,
            	SRC.AFRU_RMZHL          AS OPERATION_CONFIRM_COUNTER,
            	SRC.AFVU_USR04          AS ACCT_IND,
	
            /* --- Date conversions (cf_varchar8_to_date: YYYYMMDD -> DATE) --- */
	
            	CASE
            	    WHEN LEN(SRC.AFRU_ERSDA) = 8 AND SRC.AFRU_ERSDA NOT IN ('00000000','')
            	    THEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, SRC.AFRU_ERSDA, 112)
            	    ELSE NULL
            	END AS ENTRY_CREATE_DATE,
	
            /* --- Actual work: reverse sign when STZHL (cancellation) set --- */
	
            	CASE
            	    WHEN SRC.AFRU_STZHL <> '00000000'
            	    THEN SRC.AFRU_ISMNW * -1
            	    ELSE SRC.AFRU_ISMNW
            	END AS ACTUAL_WRK,
	
            	SRC.AFRU_ISMNW          AS ACTUAL_WRK_RAW,
            	SRC.AFRU_OFMNW          AS REMG_WRK,
	
            /* --- Actual work in hours (MIN -> HR, then apply sign) ---
				Step 1: if UOM = 'MIN', divide by 60, else keep as is
				Step 2: if cancellation row (STZHL <> '00000000'), negate         */
	
            	CASE
            	    WHEN SRC.AFRU_STZHL <> '00000000'
            	    THEN CASE
            	             WHEN UPPER(SRC.AFRU_ISMNE) = 'MIN'
            	             THEN (SRC.AFRU_ISMNW / 60.0) * -1
            	             ELSE SRC.AFRU_ISMNW * -1
            	         END
            	    ELSE CASE
            	             WHEN UPPER(SRC.AFRU_ISMNE) = 'MIN'
            	             THEN SRC.AFRU_ISMNW / 60.0
            	             ELSE SRC.AFRU_ISMNW
            	         END
            	END AS ACTUAL_WRK_IN_HRS,
	
            /* --- Remaining work in hours (same pattern, uses OFMNW/OFMNE) --- */
	
            	CASE
            	    WHEN SRC.AFRU_STZHL <> '00000000'
            	    THEN CASE
            	             WHEN UPPER(SRC.AFRU_OFMNE) = 'MIN'
            	             THEN (SRC.AFRU_OFMNW / 60.0) * -1
            	             ELSE SRC.AFRU_OFMNW * -1
            	         END
            	    ELSE CASE
            	             WHEN UPPER(SRC.AFRU_OFMNE) = 'MIN'
            	             THEN SRC.AFRU_OFMNW / 60.0
            	             ELSE SRC.AFRU_OFMNW
            	         END
            	END AS REMG_WRK_IN_HRS,
	
            	'H' AS WRK_IN_HRS_UOM,
	
            /* --- ETL system source code derived from client (MANDT) ---
			  cf_etl_src_sys_cd() function maps MANDT to source system code   */
	
            	CASE SRC.AUFK_MANDT
            	    WHEN '100' THEN 'ECC100'
            	    WHEN '200' THEN 'ECC200'
            	    WHEN '300' THEN 'ECC300'
            	    ELSE 'ECC' + SRC.AUFK_MANDT
            	END AS ETL_SRC_SYS_CD,
	
            	SRC.AUFK_MANDT

        	FROM CTE_SOURCE AS SRC

        	/* -- Segment key lookup (VBAK_ZZMARKET_CODE -> EDW_T_D_MST_SEGMENT) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_SEGMENT_CUR_D   AS D_SEG
        	       ON  D_SEG.SEG_ID = SRC.VBAK_ZZMARKET_CODE
        	       AND D_SEG.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Service order key lookup (AUFK_AUFNR -> EDW_T_D_PRD_SERVORD) -- */
	
        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_PRD_SERVORD_CUR_D   AS D_SORD
        	       ON  D_SORD.SERVC_ORDER     = SRC.AUFK_AUFNR
        	       AND D_SORD.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Company key lookup (AUFK_BUKRS -> EDW_T_D_MST_CMPNYCD) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_CMPNYCD_CUR_D   AS D_CMPNY
        	       ON  D_CMPNY.CMPNY_CD       = SRC.AUFK_BUKRS
        	       AND D_CMPNY.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Profit center key lookup (AUFK_PRCTR -> EDW_T_D_MST_PROFCTR) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_PROFCTR_CUR_D   AS D_PRCTR
        	       ON  D_PRCTR.PROFT_CNTR_ID  = SRC.AUFK_PRCTR
        	       AND D_PRCTR.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Sales order key lookup (AUFK_KDAUF -> EDW_T_D_SAL_SALORDH) -- */
 
        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_SAL_SALORDH_CUR_D   AS D_SALORD
        	       ON  D_SALORD.SALES_ORDER_ID = SRC.AUFK_KDAUF
        	       AND D_SALORD.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Sold-to customer key lookup (VBAK_KUNNR -> EDW_T_D_MST_CUSTOMR) -- */
	
        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_CUSTOMR_CUR_D   AS D_CUST
        	       ON  D_CUST.CUST_ID          = SRC.VBAK_KUNNR
        	       AND D_CUST.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND  = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Work center key lookup (AFVC_ARBID -> EDW_T_D_MST_WORKCTR) -- */
 
        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_WORKCTR_CUR_D   AS D_WRKCTR
        	       ON  D_WRKCTR.OBJ_ID         = SRC.AFVC_ARBID
        	       AND D_WRKCTR.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Cost center key lookup (CRCO_KOSTL -> EDW_T_D_MST_COSCNTR) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_COSCNTR_CUR_D   AS D_COSCTR
        	       ON  D_COSCTR.COST_CNTR_ID   = SRC.CRCO_KOSTL
        	       AND D_COSCTR.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Posting date key lookup (AFRU_BUDAT -> EDW_T_D_MST_DATE) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_DATE_CUR_D      AS D_PSTDT
        	       ON  D_PSTDT.DATE_KEY         = SRC.AFRU_BUDAT
	
        	/* -- Operating plant key (AFRU_WERKS -> EDW_T_D_MST_PLANT) -- */
	
        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_PLANT_CUR_D     AS D_OPLNT
        	       ON  D_OPLNT.PLNT_ID          = SRC.AFRU_WERKS
        	       AND D_OPLNT.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND  = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Personnel key (AFRU_PERNR -> EDW_T_D_MST_PERSONL) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_PERSONL_CUR_D   AS D_PERNR
        	       ON  D_PERNR.PERSONEL_NUM     = SRC.AFRU_PERNR
        	       AND D_PERNR.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND  = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Activity type key (AFRU_LEARR -> EDW_T_D_MST_ACTTYPE) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_ACTTYPE_CUR_D   AS D_ACTTYP
        	       ON  D_ACTTYP.ACTIVITY_TYP_ID = SRC.AFRU_LEARR
        	       AND D_ACTTYP.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Planning plant key (AFIH_IWERK -> EDW_T_D_MST_PLANT) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_PLANT_CUR_D     AS D_PLPLNT
        	       ON  D_PLPLNT.PLNT_ID         = SRC.AFIH_IWERK
        	       AND D_PLPLNT.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Sales area key (VKORG/VTWEG/SPART -> EDW_T_D_SAL_SALAREA) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_SAL_SALAREA_CUR_D   AS D_SALAREA
        	       ON  D_SALAREA.SALES_ORGZTN   = SRC.VBAK_VKORG
        	       AND D_SALAREA.DISTRBN_CHNL   = SRC.VBAK_VTWEG
        	       AND D_SALAREA.DIVISION       = SRC.VBAK_SPART
        	       AND D_SALAREA.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Order creation date key (AUFK_ERDAT -> EDW_T_D_MST_DATE) -- */
	
        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_DATE_CUR_D      AS D_CREDT
        	       ON  D_CREDT.DATE_KEY         = SRC.AUFK_ERDAT
	
        	/* -- Parent customer key (ZH_KUNN2 from KNVP -> EDW_T_D_MST_CUSTOMR) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_CUSTOMR_CUR_D   AS D_PCUST
        	       ON  D_PCUST.CUST_ID          = SRC.ZH_KUNN2
        	       AND D_PCUST.ETL_CURR_RCD_IND  = 'Y'
	
        	/* -- Technical completion date key (AUFK_IDAT2 -> EDW_T_D_MST_DATE) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN GLOBAL_EDW_DSP.GLOBAL_EDW.EDW_T_D_MST_DATE_CUR_D      AS D_TECHDT
        	       ON  D_TECHDT.DATE_KEY        = SRC.AUFK_IDAT2
	
        	/* -- Reason for variance description (TRUGT lookup) -- */
 
        	LEFT JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.TRUGT AS TRG WITH (NOLOCK)
        	       ON  TRG.SPRAS = 'E'
        	       AND TRG.WERKS = SRC.AFRU_WERKS
        	       AND TRG.GRUND = SRC.AFRU_GRUND
	
        	/* -- Accounting indicator description (TBMOTX lookup) -- */

        	LEFT JOIN ECC_CORE.ECC_CORE.TBMOTX  AS BMOT WITH (NOLOCK)
        	       ON  BMOT.SPRAS = 'E'
        	       AND BMOT.BEMOT = SRC.AFRU_BEMOT
	
        	/* Filter: only process rows where a valid service order key was resolved */
	
        	WHERE ISNULL(D_SORD.SERVC_ORDER_KEY, -1) <> -1
				AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE,SRC.AFRU_BUDAT,112) >= '2026-01-01'
        		--AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE,SRC.AFRU_BUDAT,112) < '2026-01-01'
		)
SELECT *
FROM CTE_TRANSFORMED;
